kits.title: Universal Base Characters [Standard]

acquisition.reason: The pack page's download buttons are itch.io's per-download token flow (Itch.attachBuyButton); there is no stable direct URL, and quaternius.com/packs/*.html links nothing else. github.com/Quaternius publishes no kit repository.

kits.notes: The free Standard download is glTF/FBX/OBJ with a portion of the models and no rigged .blend (the .blend files are the paid Source version). Sizes and sha256 below were computed on first fetch.

firstFetch.note: First fetch on 2026-10-24 staged these bytes from the owner's marcusrbrown/panthea checkout (tools/render/kits/..., the owner's earlier download of the same Standard pack), not from itch.io; every sha256 equals the one that checkout's tools/render/kits.json records. Re-download from downloadPage and run fetch-kits.sh --from <dir> to confirm against upstream.
